provenance_chain: Investigation Event -> Agent Proposal -> Grounding Result -> Claim Disposition -> Finding -> Analyst Review -> Forensic Evidence
task_scoping: EvidenceResolver strictly checks task output_files_db and output_events_db; cross-task references are rejected with 422.

epistemic_invariants.HYPOTHESIS_preservation: Candidates with claim_type HYPOTHESIS remain HYPOTHESIS upon acceptance (assertion_class=HYPOTHESIS).
epistemic_invariants.unsupported_FACT_blocked: Candidates with claim_type FACT lacking valid evidence references are blocked from acceptance with 422.
epistemic_invariants.analyst_note_exclusion: References with prefixes analyst_note: or summary: are strictly blocked from evidence resolution.
